discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B013 (packet 213). 30 standard searches, snippets/summaries only, German translated. dein-dlrp indexed only Apr, Jun, Oct 2018 (+ July intro). My Cat series 2018 spans several set keys (Apr Lucifer, May Jasmine, Jun Oliver, Jul Felicia, Sep Jazzy, Oct Duchess, Dec Figaro) - consider series grouping; likewise Chateau (Lady, Cinderella) and parade float (Belle, Elsa) series. Annual Pass set reuses B013 key. Ursula BTM may belong to Fun Adventures. Spider-Man/Marvel June conflicting.
